BiblicalUsage: Enan is an Israelite. In Numbers 1:15, the text says "Ahira the son of Enan." The life behind the name is told on the Enan People profile.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Enan matters because God knows His people by name, and Enan is one of them. That is why I want the name, and the person behind it, kept straight.
